description: Defines the AudioEndpointParcelable class, which manages shared memory and file descriptors for message queues and stream information in the AAudio API, including methods for updating, resolving, and serializing endpoint data.

classes.name: AudioEndpointParcelable
classes.description: Manages shared memory and file descriptors for AAudio message queues and stream info, providing methods for updating, resolving, and serializing endpoint data.

methods.name: addFileDescriptor
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor to the internal table, returning its index or a negative error code.

methods.name: closeDataFileDescriptor
methods.description: Closes the current data file descriptor, closing the duplicated FD.

methods.name: updateDataFileDescriptor
methods.description: Updates the data file descriptor with information from another endpoint parcelable, returning success or error code.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves an EndpointDescriptor into internal structures.

methods.name: resolveDataQueue
methods.description: Resolves a RingBufferDescriptor into internal structures.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes resources associated with the parcelable.

methods.name: parcelable
methods.description: Returns a parcelable representation of the object, transferring ownership.
